abstraction.description: Real code added 12 to the hour for PM times with no upper-bound check; when hour was already 12 (12 PM), the result (24) is out of datetime's valid 0..23 range (real GitHub issue #16). Fix subtracts 24 and rolls the day over when the sum exceeds 23. Modeled as pure int arithmetic, sidestepping the actual datetime.py operational model entirely (not yet confirmed to validate hour range) by asserting the 0..23 invariant directly.
